map.两版文案/配置文件差异：并排高亮新增、删除、修改的行，快速定位改动。: Diffing two copy versions or config files: highlight added, removed and modified lines side by side to pinpoint changes quickly.
map.翻译校对付对：把原文与译文按行对比，检查漏译或错位。: Translation proofreading: compare source and translation line by line to catch omissions or misalignment.
map.合并冲突预检：提交前看本地与基线文本的差异。: Pre-merge conflict check: review differences between local and baseline text before committing.
map.左栏贴旧版、右栏贴新版，工具标出第 3 行「退款时限 7 天」改为「15 天」、: Paste the old version on the left and the new on the right; the tool marks line 3 changing from "refund window 7 days" to "15 days" and line 5 as added, so substantive changes are obvious at a glance.
map.行级和字符级有什么区别？: What is the difference between line-level and character-level?
map.行级按整行比对，适合段落/配置；字符级（如 text-diff）精确到字符，适合: Line-level compares whole lines, suiting paragraphs and configuration; character-level (such as text-diff) goes down to individual characters, suiting small in-sentence edits. Pick a tool by text granularity.
map.基于 LCS/Myers 差分，超大文本（数十万行）内存与耗时上升，建议先按段落: It uses LCS/Myers diffing; very large text (hundreds of thousands of lines) raises memory and time, so split by paragraph or sample first.
